bash.name: Bash
bash.summary: Heavy melee hits can become a future short stun or knockback effect.

heal.name: Heal
heal.summary: Restores hit points to a friendly unit once the ability system is active.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.summary: Launches a splash-damage projectile once the ability system is active.

castle_upgrade.name: Castle Upgrade
castle_upgrade.summary: Allows a king to improve a friendly castle.

gather.name: Gather
gather.summary: Allows a worker to collect gold, stone, wood, or food.

build.name: Build
build.summary: Allows a worker to construct buildings.
